defaults.reporting: continuous measurements and complete per-metric rankings

optional_presets.role: descriptive annotation only; no row deletion or change to fitted module assignment
optional_presets.closed_state: not_applied; candidate booleans missing rather than false
optional_presets.basis: Katana operational choices, not universally calibrated literature cutoffs

continuous_outputs: all-edge and cross-gene connectivity with complete ranks

threshold_dependent_legacy_evidence.composite_membership_score: retain with explicit legacy identity; split-half discrete labels contribute to this score
threshold_dependent_legacy_evidence.preset_bootstrap_selection_frequency: retain as preset-specific sensitivity evidence, not biological truth probability or a required default rank

not_changed: WGCNA network fit and fixed module assignments
native statistical effects, P values and correction families
mathematical input validity and experimental-unit requirements
original application and completed research deliveries
report_requirements: actual source policy and labeling switch
actual configured optional rule values, distinguished from applied values
method references versus uncalibrated operational cutoffs
missing, not applied, not computed and not estimable remain distinct
no backfill of missing historical policy from current defaults

evidence.supports: definition of eigengene membership, not Katana's exact membership cutoffs
within-module adjacency sum, not a compulsory top-ten-percent rule
BH adjustment procedure; 0.05 is the selected reporting convention
bootstrap Jaccard interpretation guidance; not calibration of Katana's combined stability score

implementation.test_scope: Synthetic output/configuration/cache/CLI/UI/report regression and local native R/WGCNA fixtures; no experimental study rerun or new biological validation
implementation.cache_boundary: Versioned annotation views preserve raw scientific outputs. Label-only changes reuse verified completed measurements; unknown legacy fits are not claimed as verified current-format cache hits.
